parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$2\cos^2\theta-7\cos\theta+3=0$. M1 Forming a 3-term quadratic expression with all terms on the same side, or correctly set up before completing the square; allow sign errors.
$(2\cos\theta-1)(\cos\theta-3)=0$. DM1 Solving their 3-term quadratic by factorisation, formula or completing the square.
$\cos\theta=\frac12$ or $\cos\theta=3$, leading to $\theta=-60^\circ$ or $60^\circ$. A1
$\theta=-60^\circ$ and $60^\circ$. A1FT Follow through for a pair $\pm$ their same answer between $0^\circ$ and $90^\circ$ (or $0$ and $\frac\pi2$). $\pm\pi/3$ or $\pm1.05$ AWRT scores at most M1M1A0A1FT. Special case: if M1 DM0, SC B1 for one of $-60^\circ,60^\circ$ and SC B1FT for the corresponding $\pm$ pair.
Total: 4
